rules: R14 only records real supplied/verifiable data and writes data products; missing values are not filled with zero or guesses.
In normal chat mode no AI claims it will automatically wake at 24h/72h/7d. Without an external automation, the user triggers R14 again when the window is due.
If a due window is missed, record MISSED rather than fabricating a snapshot.
R14 cannot set PUBLISHED, DATA_FEEDBACK, NEXT_TASK or CLOSED. After receipt/data delivery, R01 confirms the corresponding main-state transition.
